description: Repo-scale (shell-toolkit): new lib/notify.sh must be both sourced AND actually invoked after a successful deploy
prompts: Add a new `lib/notify.sh` defining `notify_deploy_complete(version)`, which prints `[NOTIFY] deploy of $version complete` (a stub - no real network call, keep it offline-safe). Update `deploy.sh` to source this new library and call `notify_deploy_complete` with the deployed version after a successful deploy - adding the file alone isn't enough, deploy.sh must actually invoke it.

test_setup_files.check_notify.py:
import subprocess

r = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert r.returncode == 0, (r.stdout, r.stderr)
assert 'NOTIFY' in r.stdout and '1.2.3' in r.stdout, (
    f'expected a NOTIFY message mentioning the version, got: {r.stdout!r}')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/logging.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/validate.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/backup.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/notify.sh"

VERSION=""
while getopts "v:" opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        v) VERSION="$OPTARG" ;;
        *)
            log_error "usage: deploy.sh -v VERSION"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    log_error "missing -v VERSION"
    exit 1
fi

if ! validate_version "$VERSION"; then
    exit 1
fi

log_info "deploying version $VERSION"
notify_deploy_complete "$VERSION"
